name: The Encounter
source:
Ever been curious about how an encounter with Jesus Christ would go? Here's your answer.
This is a choice game or a visual novel where you can ask Jesus a myriad of questions, get Jesus to tell you stories or tell Jesus where to get off. It's entirely up to you!
No matter what your beliefs about Jesus, you can decide what to say and what to do and take a number of paths to find out how the encounter has affected you.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140917174644/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=godline.com.au]Google Play[/url]]
